To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the transcription of genes encoding the catabolite enzymes of the anionic monosaccharide sulfoquinovoses in Escherichiacoli K-12 is repressed by the DeoR-type transcription factor CsqR, which is induced by the substrate itself.
YihW (now CsqR) acts as a repressor of the transcription units for catabolizing SQ in E. coli K-12.

YihW is a repressor for the transcription of genes involved in the catabolization of SQ, and that the SQ-induced de-repression of CsqR is the key to the utilization of SQ as carbon source by Escherichia col K-12.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a regulatory mechanism for the catabolisation of SQ, which is a novel carbon and energy source for E. coli.
the discovery and characterization of a novel regulatory protein, CsqR (previously YihW), which is involved in the catabolite regulation of the SQ catabolism genes in E. coli.

the identification of the binding sites and the regulatory function of the uncharacterized Deoxyribo-Nucleic Acid binding protein YihW, which was renamed CsqR (Catabolism of Sulfoquinovose Regulator).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

CsqR (previously YihW), a TF belonging to the DeoR family, acts as a transcriptional repressor of the genes involved in the catabolisation of SQ, the hydrolysis product from sulfoquinovosyldiacylglycerol, in E. coli K-12.
CsqR functions as an SQ-inducible repressor for all transcription units of the catabolic genes of SQ.
CsqR (formerly YihW) is a repressor of transcription of the genes encoding SQ catabolic enzymes in E. coli K-12 and is regulated by SQ as inducer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the catabolite repression of the yihUTV operons by YihW (CsqR) is relieved by SQ as inducer in E. coli K-12.
CsqR is a novel transcriptional repressor of the DeoR-family, which is involved in the transcriptional regulation of the catabolic genes for SQ.
YihW (CsqR) is a novel regulator for SQ catabolism in E. coli K-12.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the YihUTSV genes are regulated by a novel TF, CsqR, which is a member of the DeoR-family of TFs.
CsqR, a member of the DeoR family, is the first example of a TF regulating the utilization of anionic sugars.
CsqR is a novel regulator that is specific to the catabolites of SQ and SQDG.
